from common import *
import shutil
from backtest.scripts.maintenance import experiment_harness as native
from backtest.scripts.maintenance.experiment_archive import scan_experiment_archives,ensure_experiment_metadata
from backtest.scripts.register.experiment_registry import load_registry
from backtest.scripts.maintenance.cleanup_experiment_artifacts import build_cleanup_plan
STATE=BASE/'docs/harness-state.json'
def event(key,**kw):
    s=native.inspect_state(STATE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=False)
    return native.append_event(STATE,dict(type=key,**kw),expected_revision=s['revision'],repo_root=ROOT)
def main():
    save_source(__file__)
    pr=read(PROGRESS);d=read(BASE/'metrics/four-style-comparison.json');jobs=pr['jobs']
    assert len([x for x in jobs if x['status']=='succeeded'])==20
    s=native.inspect_state(STATE,repo_root=ROOT,check_drift=False)
    assert s['status']=='stopping' and all(j['outcome']!='running' for j in s['jobs'].values())
    auditdir=BASE/'docs';f=auditdir/'cleanup-dry-run.json'
    args=[sys.executable,'backtest/scripts/maintenance/cleanup_experiment_artifacts.py','--result-retention','platform','--only-result']
    with f.open('w') as out:subprocess.run(args,stdout=out,cwd=ROOT,check=True)
    dry=read(f); rows=load_registry(ROOT/'backtest/experiments/registry.jsonl');my=next(row for row in reversed(rows) if row['exp_id']==EID)
    assert not dry['errors'],dry['errors'];keep={str(Path(x).resolve()) for x in dry['keep_result_dirs']};owned={str((ROOT/x).resolve()) for x in my['result_dirs']}
    assert owned<=keep,owned-keep
    predicted=[(ROOT/ref['path']) for k in STYLES for ref in [read(auditdir/f'predictions-{k}.json')['ensemble'],*[c['prediction'] for c in read(auditdir/f'predictions-{k}.json')['components']]]]
    assert len(predicted)==24 and all(p.is_file() for p in predicted)
    ml=[]
    for path in sorted((BASE/'metrics').glob('account-*.json')):
        doc=read(path)
        if 'source_report' not in doc:continue
        check(doc['source_report']);check(doc['portable_daily'])
        ml.append(dict(session=doc['session_dir'],required_report=doc['source_report']))
    assert len(ml)==(6 if d['qualified'] else 0)
    # Prior runs owned by other users/tasks may appear on this machine; never delete those.
    deletion={str(Path(x).resolve()) for x in dry['delete_result_dirs']} & owned
    assert not deletion,deletion
    files=[p for p in TMP.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
    allowed_scripts={'setup.py','common.py','run.py','strategy.py','finalize.py','postprocess.py','close.py','infer.py','evaluate.py','four_routes.py','panic_replay.py','routing_diagnostic.py'}
    allowed_names={'official-evaluation-inputs.pkl'}
    for p in files:
        if p.parent.name=='__pycache__' and p.suffix=='.pyc':continue
        assert p.parent==TMP and (p.name in allowed_scripts|allowed_names or (p.suffix=='.pkl' and p.name.startswith(('valid-','formal-features-','weekly-h5-rankic-infer-')))),p
    for n in allowed_scripts:
        src=TMP/n
        assert (BASE/'docs'/('adapter-'+src.stem+'.json')).is_file() and read(BASE/'docs'/('adapter-'+src.stem+'.json'))['source_text']==src.read_text(),n
    manifest=[dict(name=str(x.relative_to(TMP)),size=x.stat().st_size) for x in files]
    write(auditdir/'cleanup-manifest.json',{'directory':str(TMP),'files':manifest,'bytes':sum(x['size'] for x in manifest)})
    assert TMP.parent==Path('/private/tmp') and TMP.name.startswith('qlib-weekly-rankic.')
    shutil.rmtree(TMP);assert not TMP.exists()
    doc=dict(temporary='cleaned',result='no_changes',mlruns='handled' if ml else 'not_applicable',retained_results=sorted(my['result_dirs']),temporary_files_removed=len(files),model_sessions=20,raw_predictions=24,account_mlruns_dependencies=ml,non_task_candidates_left_untouched=dry['delete_result_dirs'],retention_warning_count=len(dry['warnings']))
    cp=auditdir/'cleanup.json';write(cp,doc);event('cleanup',outcome='complete',audit=str(cp));s=event('close');assert s['status']=='closed'
    ensure_experiment_metadata(ROOT,my)
    assert not scan_experiment_archives(ROOT)['errors']
    print('Closed',s['status'],'deleted',len(files),'temporary files',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
purpose: Task-only adapter; source retained as audit, executable removed at closure.
